**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Order Date:** May 14, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 47.3 kg/m² (obs-002), exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has essential hypertension (I10), diagnosed August 14, 2021 (cond-003), which qualifies as an obesity-related comorbidity.

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial (doc-004). Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation and was documented as unsuccessful by the treating physician.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. CPT code 43644 is a covered bariatric procedure type.

All medical necessity criteria have been satisfied. Authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter date.

Please contact us if you have questions.
